rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical mirror.

example.english: I look in the mirror before leaving home every day.
example.traditional: 我每日出門口前都會照鏡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ceot1 mun4 hau2 cin4 dou1 wui5 ziu3 geng3

rows.note: Use this formal noun for a person, story, or event that portrays or reflects another situation.

example.english: This drama is a mirror of working-class life in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢套劇係香港基層生活嘅寫照。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 gei1 cang4 sang1 wut6 ge3 se2 ziu3
